title: 02 two shaft loom
description: Two-shaft study loom | two shafts, plain-weave swatch | Y up, front +Z
detail: Two-shaft study loom | two shafts, plain-weave swatch | Y up, front +Z · Set the beat period in seconds in Start. Try t=0, 1, 2, 3 with period 4. · Front cloth is shown as individual yarns at a deliberately enlarged gauge. · Cylinder is based at local y=0. Rotate to run beam axes along X. · Each heddle has separate upper and lower straight lengths and a closed eye. · Each pair enters opposite sheds. cos(pi*i) yields exact alternating parity. · Half-turn at each selvedge joins adjacent picks; colour transitions represent joined yarns. · Loft the boat from five hexagonal transverse sections. The bobbin is visible above the hull.
